description: PWA (Progressive Web App) - Make app installable with service worker, offline support for current itinerary and map tiles, and install prompt.
steps: 1. Create public/manifest.json with app metadata: name 'TravelMind AI', short_name 'TravelMind', start_url '/', display 'standalone', theme_color '#3b82f6', icons at 192x192 and 512x512 sizes, categories ['travel', 'lifestyle'].
2. Create placeholder icon files public/icon-192.png and public/icon-512.png (can use simple colored squares with 'TM' text initially, or generate from logo).
3. Add <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'> to index.html <head> section.

4. Create public/sw.js service worker with: install event that caches static assets (/, /offline.html, icons); fetch event with network-first strategy for navigation, cache-first for map tiles (tile.openstreetmap.org URLs), network-first for other requests with cache fallback; activate event that cleans old caches.
5. Create public/offline.html simple fallback page with 'You are offline. Some features may be unavailable.' message and styling matching the app.
6. Create src/serviceWorkerRegistration.ts with register() function that registers /sw.js on window load, and unregister() function. Register returns promise that resolves when SW is ready.
7. Call register() in src/main.tsx after ReactDOM.createRoot(...).render(...).
8. Create src/utils/offlineCache.ts with: cacheCurrentItinerary(itinerary) that stores itinerary JSON in Cache API under key '/current-itinerary'; getCachedItinerary() that retrieves it.
9. Call cacheCurrentItinerary in TripPlanner after successfully generating a trip.
10. Create src/hooks/useInstallPrompt.ts that listens for beforeinstallprompt event, stores deferred prompt, and exposes promptInstall() function and isInstallable boolean.

11. Create src/components/InstallBanner.tsx that shows at top of page when isInstallable is true. Display 'Install TravelMind AI' with Install button that calls promptInstall(). Dismissible with localStorage flag.
12. Add InstallBanner to src/App.tsx, positioned at top of page.
acceptance_criteria: App is installable on mobile devices (Add to Home Screen)
Service worker caches static assets and serves offline fallback
Map tiles are cached and visible offline after initial load
Current itinerary available offline after generation
Install prompt banner appears for eligible users (desktop Chrome, mobile browsers)
Clicking Install button triggers native install prompt
Offline page displays when navigation fails without network
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run build - production build succeeds
Manual: Open app in Chrome, open DevTools > Application > Manifest, verify manifest loads correctly
Manual: Open DevTools > Application > Service Workers, verify sw.js is registered and activated
Manual: Generate a trip, then go offline (DevTools > Network > Offline), refresh page, verify offline.html displays
Manual: With trip generated, go offline, verify map tiles that were previously viewed still display
Manual: On desktop Chrome (not localhost), verify install banner appears or ⊕ icon in address bar
Manual: Click install, verify app installs and opens in standalone window
